claims.explanation: GSK1070916 is a potent and selective inhibitor of Aurora kinases B and C, which are essential for mitosis and cytokinesis. Sensitivity likely depends on high expression of AURKB (and possibly AURKC) and intact p53-mediated post-mitotic checkpoint, leading to polyploidy and apoptosis. TP53 mutations may confer resistance by allowing cells to survive polyploidy, while oncogenic drivers like KRAS or PIK3CA might increase dependence on Aurora B for mitotic progression.

p53 loss allows survival of polyploid cells, reducing apoptosis
Secondary target; high expression may increase sensitivity

FBXW7 loss may disrupt mitotic regulation, increasing dependence on Aurora B
RB1 loss may deregulate cell cycle, increasing sensitivity
CDKN2A loss may increase proliferation and Aurora B dependence
PTEN loss may activate survival pathways, reducing sensitivity
BRAF mutation may drive resistance through MAPK survival signaling
